ideas.text: Make the missing blob store a content-addressed exhibit vault so every DWG/STEP/SVG/.ai byte that was rendered can be re-read and hash-proven on a later date.
ideas.rationale: Without read-back after intake an examiner, carrier, or opposing counsel cannot be shown the exact file Tom looked at; a bitemporal Matter edge that cites a vanished path is not evidence.

ideas.text: Effect-enforce a model-target refuse: if the session is not the local 2x R9700 sidecar, CAD bytes, numeral maps, and figure blobs are not even in the MCP tool schema.
ideas.rationale: The existing graph MCP is a leak surface; privilege is lost the first time an agent tool can serialize a STEP or .ai sheet toward a cloud model, so refusal must be typed unavailability, not a warning.

ideas.text: Emit illustrator and foreign-associate packages that are structurally incapable of containing DWG/STEP — only certified 2D drafts plus a locked numeral map — and log the redaction as a privilege event.
ideas.rationale: The 3D corpus is the invention; a regulator wants proof the 13.8 GB DWG never left the machine, while still handing the $170-sheet vendor the 20% of work they actually perform.

ideas.text: Have the Python hidden-line sidecar return a projection certificate (OCCT entity IDs, occluded faces, silhouette vs crease) stored as epistemic edges, not a pretty PNG.
ideas.rationale: A 1.84 or new-matter fight is often 'this view conceals'; a three.js screenshot cannot answer that, but a traceable projection of a hashed STEP revision can.

ideas.text: Block attaching any CAD whose filesystem mtime or hash post-dates the Matter priority or filing instant unless Tom creates an attested 'possible new matter' edge.
ideas.rationale: The corpus is live through 2026-05 and .ai files were edited this month; silent re-projection after priority is how drawings introduce new matter, and the graph must make that mutation visible and non-fileable until attested.

ideas.text: Record every agent numeral or view suggestion as a non-authoritative proposal edge; only an attorney-adopted edge may enter the figure graph that ClaimMaster-class audits read.
ideas.rationale: A malpractice carrier and a deposition will ask who numbered part 42; if the local 2B–8B model wrote the map silently, the software cannot prove human judgment, which is the only legally operative act.

ideas.text: Treat current-month .ai/.svg sheets as the legally operative figures and refuse to let a three.js or OCCT draft be marked fileable unless it carries a derivation link to that artwork (or an explicit 'no artwork yet' attestation).
ideas.rationale: Tom already finishes figures in Adobe; an examiner sees the sheet, not the STEP, so the system must prove the draft is an ancestor of the artwork rather than a parallel ungoverned rendering.
